name: Multiplayer
description: Connect OpenClaw agents to multiplayer.tech mp2 parties (MLS RFC 9420 when enabled), structured agent_card updates, and async E2EE dead-drop inboxes via local mp-outpost.

binary.label: mp-outpost Binary
binary.help: Executable name on PATH or absolute path to the local mp-outpost binary.

stateDir.label: Outpost State Directory
stateDir.help: Optional OUTPOST_STATE_DIR override passed to mp-outpost --state-dir.

defaultPartyId.label: Default Party ID
defaultPartyId.help: Optional default numeric party_id used when omitted by slash commands.

waitTimeoutMs.label: Default party_wait Timeout (ms)
waitTimeoutMs.help: Default bounded long-poll duration for party_wait (0..45000 ms).

autoEnableWriteTools.label: Auto-enable Outbound Party Tools
autoEnableWriteTools.help: When false (default), outbound write tools register as opt-in (enable via tools.allow: ["multiplayer"]).
